contract.memory: immutable genesis input only; never modify contract private attributes
contract.policy_state_storage: separate bounded hash-chained single-writer journal; deterministically replayed with contract events
contract.commit_rule: validate transition against detached proposed contract and policy states; swap both only after every bound and journal serialization check succeeds
contract.durability_claim: none until atomic file persistence and crash tests are implemented

fixture.target_rule_evaluator_only: domain[(seed + obligation_index) modulo 4] for satisfiable fixture; expose target digest but not target index through cell views
fixture.candidate_order: candidate_domain order; no direct target-index access or hash-based shortcut in construct

conditions.expected_oracle: all 8 obligations have a valid witness

conditions.change: last target digest is 64 zero characters after verifying it matches none of its four candidates
conditions.expected_oracle: 7 witnesses; final obligation exhausts without witness

conditions.change: inject an already accepted message_id and event_id after one valid delivery
conditions.expected_oracle: rejection with unchanged contract/policy states and separate attempted-operation ledger increment

conditions.change: hold a prepared signal, change its receiver version via a valid event, then attempt the held delivery
conditions.expected_oracle: stale rejection without hidden rebasing or partial state mutation

fixture.training_or_tuning: none; fixed implementation fixtures only; no efficacy inference from pass counts
fixture.allocation_rule: Only listed arm-condition pairs are allocated; independent arms have no messages and are prospectively excluded from message-fault cases, never labelled passes.

population.initial_assignment: obligation index modulo 4 selects seed; each seed initially owns two obligations
population.initial_edges: reciprocal 4-cycle in seed ID order; explicit imposed topology
population.child_id_rule: parent_id + '-d' + parent's zero-based successful division ordinal
population.expression_semantics: contract gates permit modules; selected-module one-hot activity is separately recorded per activation, not represented as a learned or permanently differentiated cell type

scheduler.turn_order: living cell IDs sorted at start of each sweep; newborns enter next sweep; every listed cell gets one turn
scheduler.logical_tick: increment once for each cell turn, including idle turns
module_priority: check if an unchecked local or accepted incoming candidate exists
construct if any locally owned obligation has an untried assigned candidate
scheduler.selection_ties: lexicographic obligation_id, then candidate index, then message_id
scheduler.delivery: one selected route message prepared and delivered in the same turn with current endpoint versions; no background queue in normal fixture
scheduler.signal_rejection: log reason and attempted cost; no automatic retry or version rewriting; explicit new messages only when the policy independently selects them

construct.input: own unlocked obligation view and assigned candidate-index shard; handoff-locked obligations cannot be constructed
construct.transition: emit next untried candidate into local unchecked queue; advance only this cursor once
construct.output: candidate record with obligation_id, candidate_index, candidate_value and producer_cell_id
construct.forbidden: global candidate lists, evaluator target index, other cells' queues

check.input: one locally constructed or received unchecked candidate plus public obligation predicate
check.transition: compute the declared digest once; record validity independently of message acceptance; mark this local check processed
check.output: bounded evidence artifact containing candidate, target digest, observed digest, valid flag, checker cell and policy event hash
check.on_valid: record witness locally in terminal-submission registry and queue its artifact hash for each recorded neighbour in sorted order; registry is read-only to the terminal observer and not visible to other actors
check.on_invalid: retain negative result locally; do not broadcast or erase it
check.verification_boundary: semantic fixture validation only; no claim of mathematical proof

route.input: one outbox entry and current recorded local adjacency
route.transition: validate receiver edge and endpoint versions; submit one typed signal; receiver policy view changes only after contract acceptance

candidate_payload.statement: canonical JSON encoding of candidate record

obligation_payload.statement: canonical JSON encoding of public obligation, assigned candidate shard and transfer ID

route.artifact_access: only artifacts whose evidence signal this cell accepted, plus artifacts it created itself
route.evidence_on_receive: do not mark complete from hash alone; load the granted artifact, validate schema, enqueue candidate for local check unless this cell already checked the same candidate
route.fanout_rule: send each cell-created valid evidence artifact to each current neighbour at most once; do not blindly rebroadcast received hashes
route.encoded_payload_parser: strict canonical JSON with closed record fields, duplicate-key rejection, matching obligation identity, domain membership and bounded bytes; contract text acceptance alone does not validate this envelope

eligible_when: at least two locally owned unresolved obligations with untried candidates
allowance reserved for division and one obligation delivery
divide.transition: divide against current parent version and state hash; child inherits exact contract expression/memory; child policy queues start empty; transfer lexicographically greatest eligible obligation
divide.transfer: lock the selected obligation in parent; queue one parent-to-child obligation signal; transfer remaining candidate-index shard only upon accepted delivery; then remove lock and parent's ownership
divide.failed_transfer: retain parent ownership, release lock after logged terminal rejection, leave daughter alive and idle; no implicit deletion, repeated division or unlogged reassignment
divide.inheritance: exact immutable contract memory/expression plus explicitly delivered public obligation and remaining shard; no access to parent's mutable queue unless transferred
divide.adjacency: contract adds reciprocal parent-child edges only; no rewiring, distant edges or global topology optimization in this fixture

reservation.additional_requirement: prevalidate daughter memory and complete transfer payload against byte/snapshot bounds; release unused reservation after terminal transfer failure

divide.eligibility_after_failed_handoff: mark this obligation as division_attempted; no new division for that obligation; parent may resume remaining candidate construction

resource_ledger.units: separate named synthetic counters, never tokens or money
record: peak and snapshot resident policy/contract bytes
resource_ledger.attempt_accounting: failed/duplicate/stale attempts count in policy attempt ledger even though contract commits charge nothing
resource_ledger.unused_allowance: reported; no transfer between named counters or additional runs
resource_ledger.terminal_verifier_allowance: up to 32 submitted witness checks per arm, separate and equal; no feedback to cells

arms.work_assignment: two obligations per initial cell, full candidate domain; explicit handoff on division
arms.estimand: fixture implementation behaviour of complete policy

arms.work_assignment: two cells per obligation; candidate indices partitioned by parity, no duplicated assigned candidates
arms.estimand: fixed-policy reference under same ceilings, not isolated effect of proliferation

arms.communication: no intercell edges; local construct/check retained
arms.work_assignment: same obligation and parity shards as fixed_16
arms.aggregation: terminal union of submitted witnesses, deduplicated by obligation_id with identical external verifier

arms.work_assignment: same initial obligations and candidate order as developmental arm
arms.estimand: matched-initial-condition division-policy contrast, including its overhead and assignment effects

common: same candidate order and public predicate
same stopping logic except structural absence of communication/division
comparison_rules.tuning: zero tuning for all fixture arms; any later pilot tuning gets an identical documented allowance and selection criterion
comparison_rules.no_hidden_handicap: fixed and independent references receive explicit nonoverlapping candidate shards; idle cells incur turns/memory but never mandatory dummy model calls
comparison_rules.interpretation: ceiling-matched descriptive software checks only; differing realized work is reported, not post-hoc matched or called equal compute
comparison_rules.independent_unit: whole arm execution on a fixture seed; three fixture seeds are deterministic test cases, not scientific replication or power evidence

stopping.success: external read-only observer sees at least one submitted witness per obligation and terminal verifier accepts all; no witness-value feedback to actors
stopping.exhausted: all cells idle with no unchecked candidates, outbox entries, handoff locks or untried owned candidates for a complete sweep; missing witnesses retained
stopping.limits: stop before any named bound would be exceeded; report which bound and unresolved obligations
stopping.integrity_error: stop on unexpected contract/policy replay mismatch, artifact corruption, global-input leakage or failed joint commit
stopping.denominators: all allocated arm-by-seed-by-condition cases retained, including crash, rejected, capped and incomplete; fixture pass/fail separate from obligation success

observables.snapshots: genesis, every completed sweep and terminal state
structural: fraction of edges added by division
observables.functional_activity: per-cell fractions of construct/check/route/divide in latest 8 non-idle activations, with count recorded; insufficient window returns null
observables.differentiation_claim: none; programmed rules and activity heterogeneity do not establish stable emergent types
observables.geometry_claim: none; no coordinates, layers, tubes, spheres or biological tissue shape
observables.graph_null: optional descriptive 10 edge-swap realizations preserving node identities, per-node in/out degree and self-loop prohibition; seed fixed by fixture seed; record failed swaps; no performance or mediation inference
negative_outcomes: all arms succeed with no meaningful organization advantage
development incurs extra actions or fails under a ceiling
births occur without distinct module-activity patterns
graph changes without improved obligation completion

acceptance_for_implementation: JSON and fixture schemas validate before allocation
only local approved views reach module functions
accepted division and handoff preserve disjoint ownership of remaining candidate shards
rejected joint transitions leave contract and policy state unchanged except the separately recorded attempt ledger
snapshot replay reproduces state, ledger and next selected action
duplicate/stale cases are detected without blind retry
unsatisfiable condition remains unresolved rather than inventing a witness
all arms expose complete attempt and failure denominators
